Stretch: explain when a noun phrase becomes too long
questions.a: When modifiers pile up and blur the image; choose the most precise, not the most.

questions.q: In 'the small splash of silver water', what is the head noun?
questions.a: A) splash. 'splash' is the main noun; 'small' and 'of silver water' modify it.
C) the main noun in the phrase
options: the main noun in the phrase

questions.q: Answer the ponder: how do extra words sharpen a picture?
